description: Election Commission - Declare that S. Kanakaraththinam as a Member of the Alayadivembu P/S
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Alayadivembu Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for local government bodies.
